L1–L20 / R1–R20 are guide row IDs, not GPIO numbers.
Match the board’s printed labels. Do not mirror this front view.
GPIO7/8 labels “SDA / SCL” belong to the onboard bus.
C6 SDIO 14–19 · C6 control 6/54 · UART console 37/38
“No external role” describes allocation, not electrical approval.
L15 GPIO2 → SDA · L14 GPIO3 → SCL
V+ and every servo plug stay disconnected.
OE HIGH = disabled · LOW permits PWM.
External reset pull-up must be verified.
OE disables signals; it does not cut servo power.

Keep native USB P1 / FS reserved.

Scope / analyzer: PWM and reset timing proof.
